purpose: Classifies every field of REPLAY_BUNDLE.json. BINDING_AND_VERIFIED fields are independently rebuilt/recomputed by scripts/replay_sealed_evolution.py; mutating any of them makes the replay CLI exit nonzero (proven by scripts/replay_mutation_battery.py). INFORMATIONAL_NOT_VERIFIED fields are carried for human context only and are NOT part of the verified surface.
verifier: scripts/replay_sealed_evolution.py (exit 0 = every binding check passed; VACUOUS runs are labeled and never called full-decision replay)

run_context.code_revision.note: recomputed over the replaying tree's src/scripts/verifier

run_context.base_commit.note: canonical repo identity; not reachable from the replay environment

run_context.python.note: interpreter patch level may differ across verifying machines

live_world.note: live targets regenerated from this seed

calibration_suite_seed.note: conformal calibration is exercised by tests, not re-verified in replay

policy_registry.note: propensities recomputed from follow_prob; resolutions re-executed

evaluator_reveal.suite_commitments.note: case counts, content hashes, truth hashes, world seeds

grown_tasks.note: recomputed via pure build_grown_task; per-growth registry manifests compared

predictions.note: champion prediction blocks recomputed bit-for-bit via shared commit_cycle_prediction

chains.lineage.note: candidate ids, snapshot ids, registry bindings, dev NLLs, statistics, states, reasons all recomputed; in-row mutation also breaks Ed25519 signatures

chains.evaluator.check: CHAIN_EVALUATOR_* + CHARGE_RESULT_PAIRING_1TO1 + TERMINAL_STATUSES_VALID + LOOK_INDICES_SEQUENTIAL + NONCES_UNIQUE + LINEAGE_REPLAYED + FINAL_AUDIT_RECOMPUTED
chains.evaluator.note: aggregate metrics and paired statistics recomputed from rebuilt suites

resolutions.note: every row re-executed through a fresh PredictionLedger; hash chain equality (excluding signed_row_hash, whose key is run-ephemeral)

resolutions[].signed_row_hash.note: binds to the outcomes chain, which is itself verified; the ephemeral signer key differs per run

informational.note: explicitly out of the verified surface (e.g. benchmark_receipt_id convenience copy)

mutation_battery: scripts/replay_mutation_battery.py — 19 mutations covering every audit-listed field class; all must exit nonzero
vacuous_rule: if zero promotion-look charges exist, the CLI prints REPLAY_RESULT=VACUOUS_INTEGRITY_ONLY and the result must never be described as full-decision replay
